scope: Manual checks of the retained-source protocol and opt-in repair, not a game-performance experiment.

runtime.harness: Locally extracted Franzen bundle with the published baseline Notebook patch applied.
runtime.sandbox: Real run_sandboxed_python subprocess using Python -I -S; timeout reduced to 1 second for the small timeout cases.
runtime.full_tool_path: Real ToolAgent._dispatch_tool with a manually constructed runtime-state fixture. Local model configuration was supplied only to construct the agent; no model endpoint was called.

manual_checks.observation: After retaining f and dependent g, defining h then entering a short infinite loop returned a hard-timeout result with no keepable_functions key. The original commit path cleared f and g.

Committed f and dependent g with math import. A timed-out call attempted to replace f, define h and create a snippet variable. The patch kept the previous source dictionary unchanged, including the import; the feedback explicitly said this failed call's definitions, changes and deletions were not saved.

manual_checks.method: A later real ToolAgent._dispatch_tool call in a fresh sandbox
manual_checks.observation: g(2.9) returned 6 from the pre-timeout math-backed implementation. The failed call's new_variable was absent and raised NameError, handled by the hand-written snippet.
A normal del f removed f; the collector also pruned g because it depended on f. The resulting present empty snapshot cleared the committed pool. The patch did not resurrect either function.

After committing ok(x)=x+4, a call successfully redefined ok(x)=x+8 and then raised ValueError. The valid snapshot accompanying that ordinary exception committed the new definition. A later fresh sandbox returned ok(1)=9.

manual_checks.method: Real isolated sandbox and original retention path
manual_checks.observation: An exception before a replacement def, or a replacement def whose default-value evaluation failed, left the old restored function binding and its dependent function retained.

manual_checks.method: Real isolated sandbox and original retention path
manual_checks.observation: A new same-name definition depending on an unavailable snippet variable was rejected, and its dependent function was pruned. The original code did not fall back to the old version; the opt-in patch leaves this present-snapshot behavior unchanged.

manual_checks.method: Synthetic action-result metadata passed through the original summary and scope-update helpers
manual_checks.observation: A same-level RESET summary did not itself clear the retained pool under levelup scope.

manual_checks.method: Synthetic missing-snapshot record and level-transition summary passed through the real commit and scope-update methods
manual_checks.observation: The repair preserved the old pool at the missing-snapshot commit point, then the normal levelup boundary cleared it. No wrapper restored the pool after that reset.

manual_checks.method: Synthetic level-transition summary passed through the real scope-update method
manual_checks.observation: Game scope kept the retained helper across the transition, matching the baseline scope behavior.

manual_checks.method: Real _ensure_session with a different runtime directory
manual_checks.observation: Changing the runtime session directory cleared the retained pool.

manual_checks.method: Real ToolAgent._dispatch_tool and hard timeout with the patch disabled
manual_checks.observation: The same missing-snapshot hard timeout cleared the old function set through the original path. Pure-function dispatch step_executed and made_progress flags remained false.

CLI choices contain baseline, goal_evidence, transient_history and program_state. Source inspection confirms the arm-specific installer, program_state.py source hash and final program-state.json diagnostics output.

source_review_only: Turn scope clears on a new non-resumption analyzer turn; this boundary was inspected, not exercised through a model turn.

Existing game actions remain in sandbox_result.action_results and flow through the original summary and dispatch. No action rollback or replay is added; no live game action was used in this CPU check.
The repair only recognizes an absent key. Present empty, malformed or collector-failure snapshots retain the original behavior; repairing those would require a separate protocol decision.

independent_review.result: No substantive issue found in missing-versus-empty handling, import/source retention, ordinary exception snapshots, reset order, action semantics or disabled behavior.

evidence_limitations: This JSON summarizes manual commands and their outputs from the task conversation; it is not an automated test suite or a saved raw sandbox transcript.
Scope transition cases used synthetic metadata and real baseline helper methods, not reconstructed original game executions.
No GPU score or game outcome has been measured for program_state. This does not establish that retained old logic is correct or explain all of experiment 006's regression.
